meta.source: Amplified Impact Motion v1, November 2026. Extends the Motion section of the Amplified Impact Web system: one curve, the logo intro at 220, 480 and 900 ms, once per view, never loop the ring, and the final frame for reduced motion.

motion.note: An element's normal styles are its final frame; keyframes only say where it starts. Springs are CSS linear() curves with a cubic-bezier fallback. Code: ai-motion.css and ai-motion.tsx.

tokens.name: aim-ease
tokens.usage: The system's curve. Arrivals, fills and state changes.

tokens.name: aim-ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: starts slow and gathers speed.

tokens.name: aim-ease-spring
tokens.usage: Travel with a 7% overshoot: label rolls, presses, panels, toasts, rises.

tokens.name: aim-ease-land
tokens.usage: The dot landing, with the logo intro's slight overshoot (12%).

tokens.name: aim-dur-base
tokens.usage: Small moves and line draws: checks, messages.

tokens.name: aim-dur-spring
tokens.usage: Springs settling: rolls, presses, drawers, toasts, rises.

tokens.name: aim-dur-fill
tokens.usage: Progress filling, and figures counting with it.

tokens.name: aim-dur-brand
tokens.usage: The logo intro, the ripple and completion moments. Once per view.

tokens.name: aim-dur-sweep
tokens.usage: One pass of the hairline sweep, the only loader.

tokens.name: aim-rise
tokens.usage: How far content travels as it arrives.

tokens.name: aim-stagger
tokens.usage: The gap between items arriving in order.

tokens.name: aim-action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover. Dark: Energy Bright lifted toward ink, Black label 13:1. Light: Forest, Bone label 8.4:1.

tokens.name: aim-scrim
tokens.usage: Black over the page behind an open drawer. Flat, no blur.
